title: 22 Years Later, Fullmetal Alchemist Fans Are Still Debating the Anime’s Original Ending
content:
When it comes to anime series, not many of them can compare to the 2009 hit Shonen Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood . It’s one of the most ambitious projects by Studio Bones, and there’s no denying that the anime made its mark in history. Whether it’s the visuals, political intrigue, action, suspense, or even the world-building, the anime stands out in almost every aspect. Not only that, but the anime is still considered one of the highest-rated series of all time. As a Shonen classic, its legacy is still unmatched even now. However, the 2009 series is actually a reboot, and the original anime is far more divisive than most fans realize.

Written and illustrated by Hiromu Arakawa , the manga began serialization in 2001 before getting an anime adaptation two years later. Studio Bones was also responsible for the original anime, which aired for one year. The original series reached its conclusion on October 4th, 2004, but it left behind a never-ending debate over its ending. While it’s not as popular as the reboot, a majority of the fans have already watched the original series, and it’s pretty obvious why it needed a reboot. The story changed considerably from the original, making it one of the most controversial adaptations of all time.

Fullmetal Alchemis t: Brotherhood Is Still Known For Its Satisfying Ending

Before we get to what really happened in the original anime, it’s necessary to consider that the majority of the reason why the debate still exists is that the original ending is just that well-written. While the reboot does have a few changes from the original, it remains overall faithful to the entire story and, of course, the ending as well. Shonen endings throughout the decades have been criticized for rushed conclusions, unanswered questions, and many other issues. Things haven’t changed even now, as seen with the finale of even hit series such as Jujutsu Kaisen and Demon Slayer .

However, this is all the more reason why Fullmetal Alchemist stands out for having one of the best endings in Shonen history . The story ended without any plot holes or rushed pacing. Instead, it gave each character their version of an ending while also giving them a goal to carry on in the future. On the other hand, the 2003 anime was airing during the manga’s serialization, which is one of the reasons why it made several changes from the original story.

After the anime caught up with the manga, the animation studio decided to write a completely original ending instead of ending the series halfway. While the manga ended in 2011, the anime already decided how things would play out in an alternate version of the story. During the early 2000s, the anime was actually popular, but things changed significantly by the end of the decade and the early 2010s. The manga came to a satisfying conclusion, and even now, rarely any Shonen series can compete with how well-written Fullmetal Alchemist ‘s ending is. This is all the more reason why newer fans are still divided over the 2003 anime’s ending.

Fullmetal Alchemist ‘s Original Anime Isn’t As Bad As Many Fans Claim

Abiding by the standards of the 2000s anime industry, Fullmetal Alchemist added several fillers and even original scenes that completely deviated from the story that Arakawa had originally intended. When the anime broke through Arakawa’s narrative, it became much darker than the manga . The series changed how the Homonculi were created, which completely shifted the tone of the story. The original manga featured that the Homonculi were created with a Philosopher’s Stone, but the 2003 anime shocked fans when it confirmed these creatures came to life after a failed human transmutation. The concept of human transmutation was a taboo in both versions of the story.

However, the original story put emphasis on how the military doesn’t want anyone to create an army of the undying. Meanwhile, the 2003 anime featured a more ethical reason, stating that these transmutations lead to the creation of such dangerous artificial life forms. Additionally, in the first anime, it was Roy Mustang who killed Winry’s parents instead of Scar, which was a major turning point in the story. However, the biggest change was of course the finale, where Envy fatally stabs Edward in the chest. Unwilling to lose his brother, Alphonse decides to sacrifice himself to save him.

However, Edward somehow transmutes himself to save Alphonse instead, which gets him trapped in our real world. While Alphonse gets his body back, Edward decides to find a way to get back home, leaving the brothers separated forever. The original anime never really reunited the brothers and ended on a bittersweet note while they remain hopeful for the future. Surprisingly enough, if one can forget about the manga, the original anime is actually considered well-written even though it has its drawbacks.

What did you think about Fullmetal Alchemist ‘s original anime? Or do you think it should have ended on a happy note instead? Let us know in the comments below.

title: Crunchyroll Is About to Release a Ton of New Anime for the Biggest Webtoon Hits
content:
Crunchyroll is teaming up with HAYATE and LINE Digital to release a ton of new anime based on the biggest Webtoon hits, and fans have gotten the first look at some of the first coming our way in the near future. Webtoon fans have been able to see some of their favorite Korean webcomics making the jump to anime in the last few years specifically, and those have resulted in some record breaking successes such as with Solo Leveling . But there are even more series with that kind of potential.

As reading Webtoons grows in worldwide popularity, it’s opened up to a whole new avenue of potential adaptations to find the next big anime hit . Taking the stage during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend, Crunchyroll has announced they are partnering with HAYATE and LINE Digital Frontier Corporation on a slate of new co-productions with the intent of adapting more Webtoons into anime. With the first look at a few of the titles revealed as well.

Crunchyroll Plans Anime for “Around” 15 New Webtoons

Crunchyroll, HAYATE and WEBTOON Entertainment’s LINE Digital Frontier Corporation are now working together to develop potential new anime adaptations for “around 15 select titles” as revealed by a new press release celebrating the partnership. Each of the titles can be found in LINE Digital Frontier’s webtoon services, and will be exclusively streaming with Crunchyroll upon their debut. While not all 15 of these titles might not make their way to screens in the future, the first three of these adaptations have been revealed during New York Comic Con 2026.

The first three titles getting their official anime adaptations include JH’s The Boxer, HereLee and SUMPUL’s The Remarried Empress , and YC and Rakyeon’s Teenage Mercenary . Both The Remarried Empress and Teenage Mercenary have revealed they are scheduled for a release some time in 2027, but a release window for The Boxer has yet to be revealed as of this initial announcement. If these shows can find success as the first major wave of this new partnership, it’ll be smooth sailing for the other titles they have planned.

What Does This Mean for Anime’s Future?

Anime fans have likely seen a lot of Webtoon adaptations over the last few years, and some of them have been much more successful than some of the traditional manga releases. Many of the biggest titles have accumulated billions of views for their original comics, and that success has translated to screens thanks to well received adaptations. If these Webtoon hits can continue to be paired with great studios and staff, then we’re bound to see much more from this partnership alone. Not to mention any other studios and companies that might want to jump on the trend.

Ultimately this also means many more quality stories are going to be available to watch through an anime. We’ve seen some earlier titles hit stumbling blocks with how they adapted their original Webtoon releases like The God of High School , but it’s much different these days as it seems like all those involved have figured out a better rhythm to go with it. As these series further make their way to screen, it’s also going to draw more interest to Webtoons too.

Which Webtoon series are you hoping to see get their own official anime adaptations in the future? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Futurama Returns With Surprise Post-Credits Scene After Season 14 Finale – Watch
content:
Futurama has officially ended another season of its revival run with Hulu, but it’s made a surprise return with a new post-credits scene revealing what happened after the final episode. Futurama had four successful seasons of its revival series with Hulu, but the animated series thankfully is far from over. The franchise has revealed that it’s now working on three new specials for Hulu , and has some more surprises in store. That includes a brand new post-credits scene for fans to enjoy after Season 14’s big finale.

Futurama Season 14 ended on a finale that was written to be yet another potential series finale for the franchise before it was renewed for its new specials with Hulu. But while the final moments of the finale put a fun button on the final adventure, Futurama returned with a brand new post-credits scene as shared with fans during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend to help bring the final episode to an even better conclusion. You can check it out below as shared by Hulu.

Futurama Finale Post-Credits Scene Teases the Show’s Future

Futurama Season 14 marks the end of an era with Hulu as it’s (currently) the final full season of the TV series planned for the streaming platform. But it’s not the end of the franchise as there are three new specials now in the works. The first is currently scheduled to release with Hulu during the 2027 holiday window, and has been teased to be an X-Mas focused adventure. There’s even a brief tease at what to expect with a flying reindeer briefly seen as the Professor teases that it’s something to come.

Futurama showrunner David X. Cohen teased to ComicBook that this new special “…involves a big Bender romance with a snowman,” and that “You’ll believe it when you see it.” It was also teased to focus more on Fry’s childhood hopes and dreams for the holiday, and would be a way for the staff to officially say goodbye to the late Coolio following passing with a tribute to Kwanzaa Bot of some kind. But that’s not all that’s in the works for the show’s future as the other specials are teasing something big.

What’s Next for Futurama?

As Futurama executive producers David X. Cohen and Claudia Katz explained to ComicBook, these new specials will be about 66 minutes each . So they won’t be as long as the previous feature length releases seen on DVD, but are being treated with the same amount of care, “Another way to look at it is basically it’s about the same amount of material as a season and we’re presenting it in a different way,” Cohen stated. “I think it could be quite exciting.” Even teasing that the third special would be following up a major theory fans have had for years too.

Futurama Season 14 was the biggest of the revival era yet. Not only did it end on what could have been yet another series finale for the long running franchise, but it also featured a crossover with Disenchantment on Netflix . This was a major team up between the two streaming services, and took quite a lot of time to put together. But with more Futurama still on the way, how do you like this new post-credits scene? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Bob’s Burgers Confirms Hulu Release Date for New Holiday Special – Watch First Look Now
content:
Bob’s Burgers might be missing out on the Fall slate thanks to a major schedule shift with Fox, but it’s coming back for the holidays with a new special coming to Hulu. Bob’s Burgers is currently in the midst of a four season renewal with Fox alongside some of the other big Animation Domination franchises The Simpsons, Family Guy and American Dad!, but there have been some changes with the network. Meaning Bob’s Burgers won’t be coming back for a new season until next year.

Bob’s Burgers won’t be coming back for a new season until sometime in early 2027 now that Fox has shifted its episodes to the midseason schedule , but thankfully this means the franchise won’t be missing out on the holiday season entirely. Bob’s Burgers will be coming to Hulu later this year with a new holiday short, and the first look has been revealed as part of the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend. You can check out the new sneak peek clip below.

Bob’s Burgers 2026 Hulu Holiday Short Confirms Release Date

Titled “On the Fort Day of Christmas,” the new Bob’s Burgers holiday short will be making its debut on December 7th with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ . The short has been teased to have the Belcher kids hoping for a record breaking amount of snow following a weather report, but not much else has been revealed about what to expect from the new holiday release. Unfortunately, however, it has been revealed to be a short so it likely won’t be running for the length of a full episode like with past holiday specials.

Bob’s Burgers releasing this new exclusive short with Hulu is part of the overall plan for the 20th Television Animation franchises that we’ve seen in the last few years. After Family Guy had its own release schedule adjusted to now release in the midseason, there have been two new exclusive specials coming to Hulu in the years since . Bob’s Burgers is now following suit with the release of its own holiday short this year to make up for the fact that it won’t be coming back until the midseason for its own broadcast.

What Does This Mean for Bob’s Burgers Holiday Episodes?

The most unfortunate result of this schedule change for Bob’s Burgers , however, is that it’s going to now miss out on the Fall slate of holidays. The Halloween, Thanksgiving, and Christmas episodes each season have been held in high regard as some of the best episodes in the series’ history, and the change in its broadcast schedule might mean that the show won’t be able to use the holidays as timely ways to celebrate. But there’s still always hope as there could be more exclusive Hulu shorts like this released in the future.

We’ve seen Family Guy and The Simpsons release exclusive specials with Hulu and Disney+ to great success outside of their usual TV broadcast seasons, so Bob’s Burgers could be kicking off a whole new era with this one. Bob’s Burgers Season 17 will be airing with Fox sometime in early 2027, so are you curious to see what’s coming in the new holiday short? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 2026’s Biggest Fantasy Movie Revival Sets U.S. Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content:
One of the year’s biggest anime movies has been a revival of a classic franchise that had been dormant for over a decade, and now it’s finally set a release date for its launch in theaters across the United States. It’s been a great few years to be an anime fan as not only are we starting to see a lot more feature films being made to hit theaters exclusively, but more of these films are getting proper international releases. But there’s one that fans have been especially curious to see in action.

Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- is the long awaited sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica film trilogy that previously wrapped up its run 13 years ago, and has officially made its debut across theaters in Japan earlier this Summer. As part of the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend, Aniplex of America have now revealed that Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- will be coming to United States theaters on January 16-19. Check out the new trailer for its launch below.

New Puella Magi Madoka Magica Movie Confirms U.S. Release Date

Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- will be coming to theaters across North America for a limited time between January 16-19. Tickets for the new film will be going on sale beginning on December 11th, and will be offered with both Japanese and English dubbed audio when it hits. Originally making its debut in theaters across Japan earlier this Summer , this new film picks up after the end of Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion and brings back the production staff from the original TV series release too.

Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- is directed by Yukihiro Miyamoto for studio SHAFT with Gen Urobuchi providing the script, Ume Aoki handling the character designs, and Yuki Kajiura composing the music. Original franchise overseers Magica Quartet helped to oversee the story for the film , and returning Japanese voice cast includes the likes of Aoi Yuki as Madoka Kaname, Chiwa Saito as Homura Akemi, Kaori Mizuhashi as Mami Tomoe, Eri Kitamura as Sayaka Miki, Ai Nonaka as Kyoko Sakura, Kana Asumi as Nagisa Momoe, and Emiri Kato as Kyubey.

How to Catch Up for the New Madoka Magica Movie

Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- took quite a while during the course of its production before it was finally ready for its launch in theaters. It had been first announced to be in the works a few years ago, but had been delayed a number of times over its production cycle to its current 2026 release date . But now that it’s set a 2027 launch for its North American debut, there’s even more time to catch up with it all in the meantime to be ready for the new movie.

It’s going to be easier than ever to catch up with the Madoka Magica franchise as Aniplex of America has also announced that its big movie trilogy will also be getting an official streaming release in the near future too. The trilogy will first be made available for streaming with Crunchyroll on November 8th, and then will hit Netflix January 2nd. Are you curious to see what’s going on in the new Madoka Magica movie? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

Originally making its debut in theaters across Japan earlier this Summer , this new film picks up after the end of Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion and brings back the production staff from the original TV series release too.

Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- is directed by Yukihiro Miyamoto for studio SHAFT with Gen Urobuchi providing the script, Ume Aoki handling the character designs, and Yuki Kajiura composing the music. Original franchise overseers Magica Quartet helped to oversee the story for the film , and returning Japanese voice cast includes the likes of Aoi Yuki as Madoka Kaname, Chiwa Saito as Homura Akemi, Kaori Mizuhashi as Mami Tomoe, Eri Kitamura as Sayaka Miki, Ai Nonaka as Kyoko Sakura, Kana Asumi as Nagisa Momoe, and Emiri Kato as Kyubey.
How to Catch Up for the New Madoka Magica Movie

Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- took quite a while during the course of its production before it was finally ready for its launch in theaters. It had been first announced to be in the works a few years ago, but had been delayed a number of times over its production cycle to its current 2026 release date . But now that it’s set a 2027 launch for its North American debut, there’s even more time to catch up with it all in the meantime to be ready for the new movie.

It’s going to be easier than ever to catch up with the Madoka Magica franchise as Aniplex of America has also announced that its big movie trilogy will also be getting an official streaming release in the near future too. The trilogy will first be made available for streaming with Crunchyroll on November 8th, and then will hit Netflix January 2nd. Are you curious to see what’s going on in the new Madoka Magica movie? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: New Avatar: The Last Airbender Prequel Series to Focus on Fan-Favorite Avatar’s Past
content:
Avatar: The Last Airbender has expanded once more with the announcement of a brand new prequel series now in the works for Paramount+, and Avatar Studios promises it will be exploring the past of one of the timeline’s most mysterious Avatars. Avatar Studios has been formed by original creators Bryan Konietzko and Michael DiMartino with Nickelodeon and Paramount in the intent of expanding the franchise with new projects. With both a new feature film and sequel series finding success thus far , an entirely new TV series has now been revealed.

Avatar Studios took the stage during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend to announce a brand new TV series now in production for a release with Paramount+. But rather than continue going further into the timeline like seen with Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender and Avatar: Seven Havens , Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos is going back into the past to showcase more of the early life of the mysterious Kuruk, who’s been teased to have one of the darkest paths thus far.

Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos to Reveal New Look Into Kuruk’s Past

Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos is now in the works for a release with Paramount+ , but has yet to confirm a release window or date as of the time of this initial announcement. Avatar: The Last Airbender co-creator Bryan Konietzko will be serving as showrunner on the new series with Avatar Studios and Nickelodeon Animation Studios, but the rest of the production staff, voice cast and more are still being kept a mystery as of this time. But what isn’t a mystery is where this new series will be taking place within the wider franchise timeline.

Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos is already an intriguing premise as Kuruk has only been seen briefly within the original animated series as one of the previous Avatars. Future releases have since extended the overall canon to reveal that Kuruk’s eventual life as the Avatar ended in a great deal of darkness and tragedy, so going back to his much younger days offers a long road to cover for the new series. Teasing the young Kuruk to be a “rebellious teenager” who chooses to master the elements on his own, we could see a whole new expansion of the lore here.

What’s Next for Avatar Studios?

Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos comes as the third major release for Avatar Studios and Nickelodeon with Paramount+, and it further proves that this return has been a success for the franchise thus far. While it seemed like there would have been some hiccups due to the disastrous launch of Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender with its leak and bump to Paramount+ , the confirmation of a new series teases that Paramount is still very much committed to a long future with Avatar Studios.

Avatar: Seven Havens has kicked off its run with Paramount+ this month with a new sequel moving the timeline forward, and was also confirmed to get two more seasons during the New York Comic Con 2026 panel. This will make four seasons of the new TV anime series in total, so there’s quite a lot on the way for fans of the franchise. But what are you hoping to see from the new Avatar Kuruk prequel? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: New Mobile Suit Gundam Seed Movie Revival Confirms U.S. Release With Original Dub Cast – Watch Trailer
content:
Mobile Suit Gundam is coming back to the big screen with a new revival of one of its most popular series, and the first look has been revealed with a new trailer gearing up for its launch next year. Mobile Suit Gundam SEED has been in the midst of a revival for the past few years. The franchise recently returned for Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom , an official feature film sequel to the events of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. But now it’s been revealed that there’s even more on the way.

Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero has now been announced by Bandai Namco Filmworks as the next major film in the franchise , but serves as a prequel to the events of the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom . Revealed during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend, this new film will be making its debut in North America next year with some voices from the original English dub cast all confirmed to return. Check out the first look trailer and poster for Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero below.

Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero Announced for 2027 North America Release

Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero is currently scheduled to first hit theaters across Japan on January 15th, and then will be making its way to theaters in North America sometime in February 2027 (with no concrete release date revealed as of this announcement). Mitsuo Fukuda will be directing the film for Sunrise and Bandai Namco Filmworks with a script provided by Chiaki Morosawa, Shigeru Morita and director Mitsuo Fukuda. Hisashi Hirai provides the character designs, and Toshihiko Sahashi will be composing the music.

Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero has also confirmed the first returning members of its English dub cast, who are coming back to the franchise years after the original SEED TV anime releases with Matthew Erickson as Shinn Asuka, Matt Hill as Kira Yamato and Sam Vincent as Athrun Zala. This new film takes place before the events of the first film, so there’s plenty of time to catch up with that previous entry now that it’s available to stream with platforms such as Netflix , Crunchyroll, Hulu, Hulu on Disney+ and more.

How to Catch Up Before Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero

There’s also no better time than ever to go back and check out the original TV anime series as Mobile Suit Gundam SEED is currently available for streaming with Gundam Channel’s official YouTube channel, and they will be offering the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny sequel series soon enough as well. There’s plenty of time to catch up with the classic anime series and movie revival releases before this new entry hits the big screen, and even more Gundam in the works.

Mobile Suit Gundam is also in the works on a brand new TV anime series at the moment too. Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO is currently scheduled for a release sometime in April 2027, and marks the start of a whole new timeline for the franchise. Following the events of the upcoming Gundam Rogue Orbit video game release, there are bound to be even more things to keep an eye on.

Are you excited to see Mobile Suit Gundam SEED returning for this new movie revival? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, September 21-27
content:
The finale of a marathon re-airing of the 10th season of the live-action A Solitary Gourmet series aired on TV Tokyo on Monday, September 21 at 5:50 p.m., and it earned a 5.1% rating. A similar marathon re-airing of season 2 aired on TV Tokyo on Wednesday, September 23 at 5:50 p.m., and it earned a 4.7% rating.

The Eiga Oshiri Tantei: Curry Naru Jiken film aired on NHK Educational on Monday, September 21 at 9:00 a.m. and it earned a 1.2% rating.

The television ratings above are an estimate of the percentage of the population that watch a given program, based on data from a survey of households in Japan's Kanto region. The ratings do not count recordings that viewers watch later.

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Confirms New U.S. Streaming Platform Ahead of Premiere
content:
Dragon Ball Super is set to finally make its highly anticipated return to screens this Fall, and the new remake series has confirmed another major streaming home where fans will be able to check it out. This weekend will see Dragon Ball Super finally kick off its return as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule with a newly enhanced version of the original TV anime series. It’s been over ten years since that anime first made its own debut, and all these years later it’s going to look and sound better than ever.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is an enhanced version of the original Dragon Ball Super TV anime series that will feature new visuals, sound effects, music and more beginning with the Battle of Gods arc. Making its official debut on October 11th in Japan , Hulu has now confirmed via press release that they will also be streaming the series alongside the episodes hitting in Japan. This makes it even easier to check out than ever before, and fans are going to want to keep an eye out for it.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Confirms Hulu Release Date

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be officially streaming with Hulu in the United States alongside its debut in Japan on Sunday, October 11th. This will be the Japanese language release with English subtitles, but an English dub release has yet to be announced for any streaming platform. Along with its upcoming release on Hulu, the new remake series will also be available for streaming with Crunchyroll , and then will be made available for streaming with Netflix beginning on October 17th. That helps to further emphasize just how big of a deal this comeback really is.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is set to go all the way back to the beginning of the original TV anime series with an enhanced version of the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F, and Universe 6 arcs. Toei Animation has been teasing that the remake series will feature “extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story.” But at this time, it’s yet to be made clear the extent of how much will actually change from that original experience.

What’s Next for Dragon Ball Super?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has also yet to reveal how many episodes it’s going to be running for, nor has it revealed whether or not future arcs will also get this new remake treatment. It’s something to keep an eye out for through the rest of the year too as Dragon Ball Super has another big project now in the works for the future. Because while the anime is coming back for this new remake, it’s also now working on a brand new anime that will finally be adapting the manga arcs that have yet to get their due.

Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol is a brand new anime series adapting the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc from the manga release. This arc introduces a brand new anime yet to be seen in anime , but has unfortunately also yet to reveal a release window or date as of this time. With so much in the works, Dragon Ball Super is ready to takeover screens once more. Are you excited for the new Dragon Ball Super remake? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
